caseNameFull: Henry N. HARPER v. TUSCARAWAS COUNTY JOB & FAMILY SERVICES

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States *81Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
